Role: Generative AI Developer

Experience: 3–5 years

Locations- Bangalore / Gurgaon / Indore / Noida / Pune / Chennai



Required Skills & Qualifications

Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in software development.
Strong proficiency in Python programming.
Hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform.
Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI concepts.
Excellent problem-solving abilities, analytical mindset, and keen attention to detail.
Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.


Roles & Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy generative AI applications using Python and cloud-based AI/ML services.
Collaborate closely with product managers, data scientists, and engineering teams to gather requirements and convert them into technical specifications for GenAI solutions.
Stay current with emerging trends and advancements in generative AI, LLMs, and related technologies.
Build and integrate APIs and services to enable seamless interaction between GenAI models and existing systems.
Write clean, efficient, reusable, and well-documented code following industry best practices.
Identify, troubleshoot, and debug application issues to ensure high performance and reliability.
Develop and maintain unit test cases to ensure code quality and robustness.


Good-to-Have Skills & Experience

Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and working with microservices architectures.
Hands-on experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks and implementations.
Familiarity with LangChain or similar orchestration frameworks.
Working knowledge of AWS Cloud.
